info.name: Vopay Debit Card Endpoints API
info.description:
Operations tagged Debit Card Endpoints across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: vopay-payment-method-api-reference.json, vopay-payment-rails-api-reference.json. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

urlencoded.description: (Required) URL to redirect the user to after a card is added.
When provided, the credit card added will be attached to the Client Account ID
This parameter accepts InnerRedirect, OuterRedirect, and JavascriptMessage as parameter values.
When set to true, the card added will be linked to your VoPay account. Default is false.
When set to true, the card type will be validated to ensure the entered information represents a debit card. Default is false.
When set to true, 3DS authentication will be triggered during the card addition process. Default is false.

request.description: This endpoint is used to generate a unique URL to embed into your application using an iFrame. End users will use this to provide their card information, which can be used in the /debit-card/oct/push-funds and /debit-card/aft/pull-funds endpoint.

request.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a debit card associated with your VoPay account

urlencoded.description: Identify card as default debit card

request.description: This endpoint allows you to identify a debit card as belonging to the VoPay account holder. Optionally, you can use this endpoint to identify a debit card as being the VoPay account holder's default debit card. Note, a VoPay account can only have one default debit card.

urlencoded.description: Identify card as default debit card

query.description: When provided, this endpoint will return the default debit card associated with this Client Account ID

request.description: This endpoint retrieves the default debit card associated with your VoPay account

query.description: When provided, this endpoint will return the default debit card associated with this Client Account ID

urlencoded.description: (Required) The token identifying the debit card to charge (returned from /debit-card/generate-embed-url).
(Required) The amount to send to the customer's debit card.
3 character currency code for the currency to sent to the customer's debit card. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency (CAD).
A unique key which the server can use to recognize and reject subsequent retries of the same request.

The parent transaction where the withdrawal will be linked to, can become a split payment with multiple withdrawals. When funds of the parent transaction have been released the system will generate the distributions of these funds automatically.
An optional unique identification general ledger code.

CPA transaction code. Use the /api/v2/account/transactions/codes endpoint to retrieve a list of valid transaction codes. If not specified, the transaction will be created using code 450 (miscellaneous).

request.description:
This endpoint is used to instantly send funds from your VoPay account to the debit card linked to the provided CardToken.

If a ClientAccountID is provided, the client account's default card will be used for the transaction.

Note: You must first generate a CardToken using the /debit-card/generate-embed-url endpoint.

request.description: This method is used to look up and return the full details on a single OCT transaction. OCT transactions sends money from your VoPay account directly onto the customer's debit card.

request.description:
This endpoint is used to instantly pull funds from your debit card linked to the provided CardToken to fund your VoPay account.

If a ClientAccountID is provided, the client account's default card will be used for the transaction.

Note: You must first generate a CardToken using the /debit-card/generate-embed-url endpoint.

request.description: This method is used to look up and return the full details on a single AFT transaction. AFT transactions pull money from you debit card directly into your VoPay account .
